Explore Private Mentorship
When the Old Ways Stop Working

At some point, the answer is not to try harder.

You may have built your life through discipline, responsibility, and hard work.

Those strengths still matter. But they may not be what every part of your life is asking of you.

You may be accustomed to anticipating what others need, putting yourself last, or quietly carrying more than anyone sees.

You may understand the situation and still find yourself unable to think your way through it.

It is to see differently. That is where this work begins.

Private Mentorship

I work privately with a small number of women over six to twelve months.

We begin with what is asking for your attention now.

A decision your mind keeps returning to but cannot resolve. A relationship or pattern that keeps bringing you back to the same place. A life that works on the outside, while something within it no longer feels right.

From there, we look beneath the immediate concern and stay with what is there long enough for something deeper to become clear.

Learn About Private Mentorship
What the Work Makes Room For

The aim is not to become a better version of yourself.

It is to see what has been shaping you, often outside your awareness, so you can choose differently.

As those patterns begin to soften, there is less need to manage, anticipate, or control the outcome, and more capacity to receive.

There is more freedom to know what you want, trust what you know, and make choices that are more fully your own.

About Dr. Angela Le

Decades of clinical practice with women.

Dr. Angela Le is a Doctor of Acupuncture and Chinese Medicine whose work has evolved over decades of clinical practice with women.

She is the founder of Fifth Avenue Fertility Wellness in New York City.

Her private mentorship grew from something she witnessed repeatedly in clinical practice: the concern that brings a woman in is often only part of the story.

Dr. Le has an unusual ability to see what may be difficult to see from inside your own life, and to help uncover what has been there all along.
